Container.Name: BlindPass Controller Postgres
Container.Overview: P06 controller candidate with embedded console and input page. Explicit keys init and migration required before first start. Requires a separately configured HTTPS edge on this custom network. Complete backup/recovery and migration acceptance remain unfinished.
Container.Requires: Prepare private host directories owned by 10001:10001 with mode 0700; keys and database URL files mode 0600. Use a direct local pool path for SQLite, not /mnt/user or a network filesystem. Set exact HTTPS edge peer IP and configured public origins. No host port is published. PostgreSQL profile requires a separately administered PostgreSQL 16 service on a private network.

Config.Name: Private data
Config.Description: Direct local pool path; private UID/GID 10001 mode 0700. Retained on removal.

Config.Name: Read-only keys
Config.Description: Explicitly initialize root-secret, agent-jwt-secret and issuer-key; never generate on startup.

Config.Name: Public controller URL
Config.Description: Exact HTTPS authority served by the edge.

Config.Name: Input page URL
Config.Description: Exact HTTPS input page authority served by the edge.

Config.Name: Trusted edge peer
Config.Description: Required exact edge container IP or canonical restricted CIDR; not a boolean or wildcard.

Config.Name: Protected database configuration
Config.Description: Directory mode 0700 owned by 10001; database.url mode 0600. Contains database credentials; never inline in template.
